6.378 rsInvalidBandShouldNotBeTogglable
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidBandShouldNotBeTogglable is a critical error that will occur when a Tablix element has
BandLayoutOptions specified and the Tablix has at least one dynamic member with
Visibility.ToggleItem present.
